    Pending physical formalisms #

    This namespace contains explicit mathematical models for the requested SQG, fracture-state, and Amplituhedron proposals. The structures make their physical premises visible as fields. A constructed value is a model instance, not an experimental validation of the associated proposal.

                                        GPE formulation distinctions #

                                        The abbreviation iGPE is used inconsistently in the source material. These records distinguish the three requested meanings: inverse reconstruction, inhomogeneous source-driven evolution, and the nonlinear interactive model. They are pointwise normalized records rather than PDE solvers.

                                                      theorem Signals.Pending.InverseGPEPoint.potential_eq_interactive_of_shared_state (inter : InteractiveGPEPoint) (inv : InverseGPEPoint) (h_hbar : inv.hbar = inter.hbar) (h_mass : inv.effectiveMass = inter.effectiveMass) (h_coup : inv.coupling = inter.coupling) (h_dens : inv.density = inter.density) (h_psi : inv.wavefunction = inter.wavefunction) (h_dt : inv.timeDerivative = inter.timeDerivative) (h_lap : inv.laplacian = inter.laplacian) :

                                                      When an InverseGPEPoint and an InteractiveGPEPoint share the same local wavefunction, derivatives, mass, coupling, and density, the inverse GPE record reconstructs the exact real scalar potential of the interactive GPE record: inv.potential = (inter.potential : ℂ) and (inv.potential).im = 0.

                                                                        Optically driven Faraday--Goldstone and photonic time-crystal models #

                                                                        The following finite records extract observables and model boundaries from Kaplan et al., Optically induced Faraday--Goldstone waves (2026), and Kiselev and Pan, Symmetry breaking and spatiotemporal pattern formation in photonic time crystals (2025). They do not identify Goldstone-like modes with Proca modes, do not establish zero diffraction, and do not promote a modeled time-crystal transition to a realized device without calibration and residual data.

                                                                                  Lignin-vitrimer perovskite solar and imaging boundaries #

                                                                                  The source chats use LVP for a proposed lignin-vitrimer perovskite material family spanning roll-to-roll solar membranes, direct-conversion X-ray panels, and speculative Proca phase-contrast imaging. These records retain composition, process, calibration, stability, and control data without promoting proposed material performance to a verified property.

                                                                                                    Mixed-species atmospheric scavenging #

                                                                                                    These records are a finite normalized model of the source-chat Gaussian-splat proposal.                                                                                                                                           Amplituhedron-inspired finite maps #

                                                                                                                                          The source-chat construction uses a matrix map Y = C * Z. The records below make that map executable over finite real matrices while keeping positivity as an optional condition on the input. The reciprocal chart is only a local finite-dimensional analogue of a logarithmic form; it is not a formalization of the full canonical differential form.

                                                                                                                                                              Hawking-like decoding bookkeeping #

                                                                                                                                                              The source describes a proposed chain from prepared modulation and observed homodyne data through inverse-GPE correction, inverse-QFT processing, an Amplituhedron constraint, and CP/ALS reconstruction. The records below retain that chain as finite data and residual metadata; they do not establish a physical Hawking decoder or a quantum Fourier-transform implementation.

                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Signals.Pending.finiteInverseQFT_two_hadamard (input : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
                                                                                                                                                                            finiteInverseQFT 2 input 0 = ↑(1 / √2) * (input 0 + input 1) ∧ finiteInverseQFT 2 input 1 = ↑(1 / √2) * (input 0 - input 1)

                                                                                                                                                                            For dimension 2, finiteInverseQFT 2 is the normalized 2×2 Hadamard transform: index 0 sums the two inputs with factor 1 / √2, and index 1 takes their difference with factor 1 / √2.

                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Signals.Pending.finiteInverseQFT_two_involution (input : Fin 2 → ℂ) (k : Fin 2) :
                                                                                                                                                                            finiteInverseQFT 2 (finiteInverseQFT 2 input) k = input k

                                                                                                                                                                            Applying the 2-point finiteInverseQFT twice recovers the original 2-point complex vector (H_2^2 = I_2).

                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem Signals.Pending.HawkingGrassmannianSynthesisContract.connected_gpe_potential_recovery {width height sampleCount : ℕ} (contract : HawkingGrassmannianSynthesisContract width height sampleCount) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                    contract.decoding.inverseGPE.potential = ↑contract.decoding.interactiveGPE.potential ∧ contract.decoding.inverseGPE.potential.im = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                    In a HawkingGrassmannianSynthesisContract, the shared-state InverseGPEPoint reconstructs the exact real scalar potential of the InteractiveGPEPoint.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem Signals.Pending.HawkingGrassmannianSynthesisContract.als_rank_lt_page_bond_dimension {width height sampleCount : ℕ} (contract : HawkingGrassmannianSynthesisContract width height sampleCount) (h_entropy : 2 * Real.log 10 < contract.horizonEntropyNats) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                    ↑contract.decoding.als.rank.rank < contract.pageBondDimensionLowerBound

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Whenever the Bekenstein–Hawking horizon entropy exceeds 2 * log 10 nats (S_BH / k_B > 2 ln 10 ≈ 4.605), the Page-curve entanglement bond dimension χ_Page = exp(S_BH / (2 k_B)) strictly exceeds the maximum configured ALSRank (r ≤ 10), proving that rank 2..10 ALS is a low-rank subspace filter rather than a general astrophysical black-hole state decoder.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem Signals.Pending.HawkingGrassmannianSynthesisContract.madelung_and_pointwise_igpe_potential_bridge {width height sampleCount : ℕ} (contract : HawkingGrassmannianSynthesisContract width height sampleCount) (m_phi hbar g_phi A laplacian_A S_t v_phi : ℝ) (h_pot : contract.decoding.interactiveGPE.potential = HawkingRadiation.madelungInversePotentialReconstruction m_phi hbar g_phi A laplacian_A S_t v_phi) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                    contract.decoding.inverseGPE.potential = ↑(HawkingRadiation.madelungInversePotentialReconstruction m_phi hbar g_phi A laplacian_A S_t v_phi) ∧ DDF.quantumHamiltonJacobiResidual m_phi hbar g_phi contract.decoding.interactiveGPE.potential A laplacian_A S_t v_phi = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Bridge between the Pending pointwise InteractiveGPEPoint / InverseGPEPoint potential inversion and the verified continuum Madelung / Quantum Hamilton–Jacobi inverse potential Signals.HawkingRadiation.madelungInversePotentialReconstruction: when contract.decoding.interactiveGPE.potential equals the Madelung-reconstructed potential $V_{\mathrm{rec}}$, the InverseGPEPoint recovers $V_{\mathrm{rec}}$ over $\mathbb{C}$ and the continuum QHJ residual vanishes identically.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      structure Signals.Pending.ProcaControlField :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A Pending Proca control/coupling field interface.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The coupled motive power is supplied model data with an explicit gain and residual. This record does not assert that a Proca field exists, accelerates Argon, or supplies energy from vacuum geometry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • channel : ProcaChannel
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • role : ProcaMHDFieldRole
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • frequency : Units.Frequency
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • frequency_pos : 0 < self.frequency.hz
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • frequencyMatch : self.frequency.hz = self.channel.mode.frequency
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • controlPower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • controlPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.controlPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • couplingGain : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • couplingGain_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.couplingGain
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • coupledMotivePower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • coupledMotivePower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.coupledMotivePower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • couplingPowerLaw : self.coupledMotivePower.watts = self.couplingGain * self.controlPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • couplingResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • couplingResidual_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.couplingResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • couplingTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • couplingTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.couplingTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • couplingWithinTolerance : self.couplingResidual ≤ self.couplingTolerance

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        structure Signals.Pending.ProcaMHDHypothesis :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A Pending bridge from a Proca channel to the classical Argon MHD plant.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The optical control power and motive flow power are kept separate. A reported ratio against control power alone is not the plant efficiency and does not demonstrate energy extraction from vacuum geometry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • opticalControlPower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • opticalControlPower_pos : 0 < self.opticalControlPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • opticalControlPowerLaw : self.opticalControlPower.watts = self.plant.accounting.controlPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • controlFieldPowerLaw : self.controlField.controlPower.watts = self.opticalControlPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • motivePower : Units.Power

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The total-input accounting includes both control and motive power.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A control-only Q-ratio threshold is an output-versus-control inequality.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          hypothesis.plant.accounting.efficiency ≤ 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              CW drive, resonance, and a longitudinal field label are necessary bookkeeping conditions in this model.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     A finite fracture-mediated ultrasonic transfer boundary.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The ordinary acoustic transfer remains explicit. The fracture/cavitation term is an additional measured mechanism candidate, not an assumed Proca channel or a claim that energy can pass harmlessly through tissue.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • fractureCouplingWithinTolerance : self.fractureCouplingResidual ≤ self.fractureCouplingTolerance

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • lossPower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • lossPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.lossPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • receivedPowerBalance : self.receiverPower.watts + self.absorbedPower.watts + self.lossPower.watts = self.transfer.incidentPower

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Fracture crackle, phase-slip cores, and QHD residual boundaries #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The following contracts extract the testable parts of the I/Q/fracture summary. Solid-network fracture is not identified with fluid cavitation; a phase slip is not inferred from winding alone; and homodyne/IQ data do not establish squeezing or a Bohm-potential interpretation without calibrated covariance and shot-noise controls.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Prop

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The observed phase-slip core is a candidate topological-defect record.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Instances For

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Classical inflow and DDF vortex observables #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The Magnus/Kutta-Joukowski relation is kept as an ordinary inflow control. A lift residual after this control is not itself evidence for DDF. The DDF observable record keeps circulation, Bernoulli-pressure, river-inflow, and swirl quantities separate so one of them can be calibrated independently before populating DDFFractureCommunicationEvidence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • inflowSpeed : Units.Speed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • inflowSpeed_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.inflowSpeed.metersPerSecond
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • signedCirculation : ℝ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • predictedLiftPerSpanLaw : self.predictedLiftPerSpan = self.mediumDensity.kilogramsPerCubicMeter * self.inflowSpeed.metersPerSecond * self.signedCirculation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • liftResidual : ℝ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • inflowCalibrationReference : String

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem Signals.Pending.MagnusEffectControl.predicted_lift_per_span_holds (control : MagnusEffectControl) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  control.predictedLiftPerSpan = control.mediumDensity.kilogramsPerCubicMeter * control.inflowSpeed.metersPerSecond * control.signedCirculation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Finite DDF wave-tail and Pop III gravitational-wave diagnostics #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              These records extract the measurable bookkeeping from the superfluid/DDF and Population III review chats. They preserve constitutive laws, finite tensor conditioning, detector-cutoff comparisons, and posterior metadata. They do not prove Hawking radiation, a DDF medium, a Pop III origin, or a new gravitational wave propagation law.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Finite multi-beam holography and trilateration #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The following records extract the reusable bookkeeping from the holography chat proposals. They preserve measured mask-state transfer, target-field residuals, and independent position estimates. They do not assert that an rGO-vitrimer mask is an activated metamaterial, that Gerchberg-Saxton found a global optimum, or that a successful reconstruction is Proca evidence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The apparatus may use a q-plate, spatial light modulator, geometric-phase optic, or equivalent polarization/phase element. OAM charge and a longitudinal near-field component are measured optical quantities here; neither one asserts Proca propagation or a massive photon.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        theorem Signals.Pending.HelicalBeamApparatus.beam_power_le_source (apparatus : HelicalBeamApparatus) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        apparatus.beamPower.watts ≤ apparatus.sourcePower.watts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Beam power is bounded by source power in the recorded apparatus.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        High-value longitudinal-beam application boundary #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        This record turns the most valuable near-term target into a finite classical experiment: a calibrated vector beam with a measurable longitudinal field, aperture-matched imaging data, causal communications bookkeeping, and a fixed-power process outcome. These observables do not establish a Proca mode, zero diffraction, or faster-than-light information transfer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                evidence.yieldImprovement = evidence.yieldMetric - evidence.classicalControlYieldMetric

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The yield comparison is a supplied classical process metric, not an energy-creation claim.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                DDF fracture-communication evidence boundary #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The DDF plan keeps ordinary acoustic/elastic communication as the null and requires an independently observed defect or transverse-mode quantity before introducing a DDF coupling term. A causal transverse mode is allowed; a superluminal or unsupported longitudinal interpretation is explicitly outside this contract.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • classicalTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.classicalTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • outsideClassicalTolerance : |self.classicalResidual| > self.classicalTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • couplingGain : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • couplingGain_nonzero : self.couplingGain ≠ 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • propagationMode : DDFCommunicationMode
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • pathLength : ℝ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • arrivalTime : ℝ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • emergentSpeed : ℝ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • causalArrival : self.pathLength ≤ self.emergentSpeed * self.arrivalTime

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • heldOutWithinTolerance : |self.heldOutResidual| ≤ self.heldOutTolerance

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Finite weak traces and Madelung/GP diagnostics #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The following records make the missing analytical and numerical inputs explicit. They are finite contracts for trace, jump, weak-balance, and Madelung/GP data; they are not weak-PDE theorems, numerical solvers, or fracture diagnoses.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          structure Signals.Pending.WeakTraceJumpContract :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A one-dimensional weak trace and flux-jump bookkeeping contract.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The labels identify the supplied measure, function space, trace operator, and test-function convention. The residual fields keep a prescribed jump and flux source distinct from an unexplained anomaly.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • measureLabel : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • functionSpaceLabel : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • traceOperatorLabel : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • testFunctionLabel : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • boundaryCoordinate : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • leftTrace : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • rightTrace : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • traceJump : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • traceJumpLaw : self.traceJump = self.rightTrace - self.leftTrace
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • prescribedTraceJump : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • traceJumpResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • traceJumpResidualLaw : self.traceJumpResidual = self.traceJump - self.prescribedTraceJump
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • traceJumpTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • traceJumpTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.traceJumpTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • traceJumpWithinTolerance : |self.traceJumpResidual| ≤ self.traceJumpTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • leftFlux : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • rightFlux : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • fluxJump : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • fluxJumpLaw : self.fluxJump = self.rightFlux - self.leftFlux
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • prescribedFluxJump : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • fluxJumpResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • fluxJumpResidualLaw : self.fluxJumpResidual = self.fluxJump - self.prescribedFluxJump
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • fluxJumpTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • fluxJumpTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.fluxJumpTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • fluxJumpWithinTolerance : |self.fluxJumpResidual| ≤ self.fluxJumpTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • weakDerivativePairing : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • testFunctionBoundaryTerm : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • weakBalanceResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • weakBalanceLaw : self.weakDerivativePairing = self.testFunctionBoundaryTerm + self.fluxJump + self.weakBalanceResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • weakBalanceTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • weakBalanceTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.weakBalanceTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • weakBalanceWithinTolerance : |self.weakBalanceResidual| ≤ self.weakBalanceTolerance

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            contract.traceJump = contract.rightTrace - contract.leftTrace

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The trace jump follows the supplied left/right trace convention.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Signals.Pending.WeakTraceJumpContract.flux_jump_holds (contract : WeakTraceJumpContract) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            contract.fluxJump = contract.rightFlux - contract.leftFlux

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The flux jump follows the supplied left/right flux convention.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            contract.weakDerivativePairing = contract.testFunctionBoundaryTerm + contract.fluxJump + contract.weakBalanceResidual

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The weak derivative pairing follows the supplied balance convention.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • spatialStep_pos : 0 < self.spatialStep.meters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • timeStep : Units.Duration
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • timeStep_pos : 0 < self.timeStep.seconds
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ftleWindow : Units.Duration
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ftleWindow_pos : 0 < self.ftleWindow.seconds

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The shot-noise reference, measured variance, detector calibration, and mode matching are explicit.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   • varianceTolerance : ℝ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • detectorNoise : ℝ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Regime-explicit NS, Madelung, DDF, and EHT bridge #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The bridge is layered rather than derived from Schwarzschild geometry. A nonvanishing Madelung field maps a Gross--Pitaevskii model to compressible Euler--Korteweg variables. DDF then adds a constitutive substrate, a low-Mach projection, and a shear-jamming regime. EHT ring data are observational image constraints: they are compared with metric/radiative-transfer models and do not directly measure an event horizon or a Schwarzschild radius.
