                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          structure Signals.Pending.MadelungEulerKortewegBridge :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A finite bridge from a nonvanishing wavefunction to Euler--Korteweg data.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          actionPhase means psi = sqrt rho * exp (i S / hbar) and u = grad S / m; dimensionlessPhase means the phase variable already has no hbar denominator. Keeping this convention explicit avoids a silent scale error in the velocity reconstruction.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • phaseConvention : MadelungPhaseConvention
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • hbar : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • hbar_pos : 0 < self.hbar
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • mass : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • mass_pos : 0 < self.mass
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • densityFloor : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • densityFloor_pos : 0 < self.densityFloor
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • observedDensity : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • observedDensity_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.observedDensity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • densityAboveFloor : self.densityFloor ≤ self.observedDensity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • phaseGradientMagnitude : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • phaseGradientMagnitude_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.phaseGradientMagnitude
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • velocityPotentialMagnitude : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • velocityPotentialMagnitude_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.velocityPotentialMagnitude
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • velocityPotentialLaw : match self.phaseConvention with | MadelungPhaseConvention.actionPhase => self.velocityPotentialMagnitude = self.phaseGradientMagnitude / self.mass | MadelungPhaseConvention.dimensionlessPhase => self.velocityPotentialMagnitude = self.hbar * self.phaseGradientMagnitude / self.mass
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • quantumPressureCoefficient : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • quantumPressureCoefficientLaw : self.quantumPressureCoefficient = self.hbar ^ 2 / (2 * self.mass ^ 2)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • continuityResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • continuityResidual_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.continuityResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • continuityTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • continuityTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.continuityTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • continuityWithinTolerance : self.continuityResidual ≤ self.continuityTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • momentumResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • momentumResidual_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.momentumResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • momentumTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • momentumTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.momentumTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • momentumWithinTolerance : self.momentumResidual ≤ self.momentumTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • irrotationalResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • irrotationalResidual_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.irrotationalResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • irrotationalTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • irrotationalTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.irrotationalTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • irrotationalWithinTolerance : self.irrotationalResidual ≤ self.irrotationalTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • quantumPressureIncluded : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • quantumPressureIncluded_hypothesis : self.quantumPressureIncluded
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • calibrated : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • calibrated_hypothesis : self.calibrated
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Signals.Pending.MadelungEulerKortewegBridge.velocity_potential_holds (bridge : MadelungEulerKortewegBridge) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            match bridge.phaseConvention with | MadelungPhaseConvention.actionPhase => bridge.velocityPotentialMagnitude = bridge.phaseGradientMagnitude / bridge.mass | MadelungPhaseConvention.dimensionlessPhase => bridge.velocityPotentialMagnitude = bridge.hbar * bridge.phaseGradientMagnitude / bridge.mass

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The Madelung bridge exposes its phase-convention-dependent velocity law.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Signals.Pending.MadelungEulerKortewegBridge.quantum_pressure_coefficient_holds (bridge : MadelungEulerKortewegBridge) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            bridge.quantumPressureCoefficient = bridge.hbar ^ 2 / (2 * bridge.mass ^ 2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The Madelung bridge exposes its quantum-pressure coefficient.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                structure Signals.Pending.NSDDFBridge :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A regime-explicit bridge from compressible Navier--Stokes bookkeeping to DDF constitutive data. The low-Mach branch is an approximation predicate, not an assertion that the substrate is globally incompressible.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • substrate : DDF.DDFSubstrate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • regime : DDFFlowRegime
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • sourceLabel : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • artifactReference : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • density : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • density_pos : 0 < self.density
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • densityRate : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • divergence : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • sinkRate : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • sinkRate_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.sinkRate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • continuityResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • continuityResidual_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.continuityResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • continuityTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • continuityTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.continuityTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • continuityWithinTolerance : |self.continuityResidual| ≤ self.continuityTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • continuityLaw : self.densityRate + self.density * self.divergence = -self.sinkRate + self.continuityResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • velocityMagnitude : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • velocityMagnitude_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.velocityMagnitude
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • machNumber : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • machLaw : self.machNumber = self.velocityMagnitude / self.substrate.c
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lowMachThreshold : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lowMachThreshold_pos : 0 < self.lowMachThreshold
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • incompressibilityResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • incompressibilityResidualLaw : self.incompressibilityResidual = |self.divergence|
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • incompressibilityTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • incompressibilityTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.incompressibilityTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lowMachProjectionResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lowMachProjectionResidual_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.lowMachProjectionResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lowMachProjectionTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lowMachProjectionTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.lowMachProjectionTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lowMachProjectionWithinTolerance : self.lowMachProjectionResidual ≤ self.lowMachProjectionTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • baselineViscosity : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • baselineViscosity_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.baselineViscosity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • effectiveViscosity : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • effectiveViscosity_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.effectiveViscosity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • shearRate : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • shearRate_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.shearRate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • viscosityFloorLaw : self.baselineViscosity ≤ self.effectiveViscosity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • shearJammingThreshold : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • shearJammingThreshold_pos : 0 < self.shearJammingThreshold
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • shearJammingCrossed : Bool
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • pressureResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • pressureResidual_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.pressureResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • pressureTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • pressureTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.pressureTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • pressureWithinTolerance : self.pressureResidual ≤ self.pressureTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • calibrated : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • calibrated_hypothesis : self.calibrated
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem Signals.Pending.NSDDFBridge.continuity_balance_holds (bridge : NSDDFBridge) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  bridge.densityRate + bridge.density * bridge.divergence = -bridge.sinkRate + bridge.continuityResidual

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The continuity balance exposes the compressible/sink-flow law.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem Signals.Pending.NSDDFBridge.mach_number_holds (bridge : NSDDFBridge) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  bridge.machNumber = bridge.velocityMagnitude / bridge.substrate.c

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The DDF sound-speed Mach number follows the supplied substrate speed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The low-Mach effective-incompressible branch is explicitly approximate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Prop

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A DDF bridge is calibrated when its regime-specific residual bookkeeping is closed; no branch is a theorem about the physical vacuum.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Instances For

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      DDF shear-jamming comparison for ultrasonic power transfer #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Ordinary acoustic transfer is modeled in Signals.Acoustics. The DDF extension below is a Pending, matched-condition experiment: DDF shear-jamming is a candidate constitutive state whose effect on acoustic transfer must be measured. It is not identified with brittle fracture, cavitation, or an energy source.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          structure Signals.Pending.DDFUltrasonicTransferComparison :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A matched baseline-versus-shear-jammed UPT comparison.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Both runs carry complete layered acoustic power ledgers. A resolved difference is only a candidate DDF-associated effect after calibration, matched controls, and replication; construction does not prove that DDF caused the difference.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • baselineDDFState : NSDDFBridge
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • shearJammedDDFState : NSDDFBridge
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • baselineTransfer : Acoustics.LayeredUltrasonicTransfer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • shearJammedTransfer : Acoustics.LayeredUltrasonicTransfer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • baselineMeasurement : Acoustics.TransferMeasurement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • shearJammedMeasurement : Acoustics.TransferMeasurement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • baselineMeasurementPrediction : self.baselineMeasurement.predictedPower = self.baselineTransfer.deliveredElectricalPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • shearJammedMeasurementPrediction : self.shearJammedMeasurement.predictedPower = self.shearJammedTransfer.deliveredElectricalPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • baselineMeasurementConsistent : self.baselineMeasurement.consistent
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • shearJammedMeasurementConsistent : self.shearJammedMeasurement.consistent
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • evidenceStatus : UPTEvidenceStatus
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • sameDDFSubstrate : self.baselineDDFState.substrate = self.shearJammedDDFState.substrate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • baselineNotShearJammed : self.baselineDDFState.regime ≠ DDFFlowRegime.shearJammed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • baselineBelowJammingThreshold : self.baselineDDFState.shearRate < self.baselineDDFState.shearJammingThreshold
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • shearJammedRegime : self.shearJammedDDFState.regime = DDFFlowRegime.shearJammed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • shearThresholdExceeded : self.shearJammedDDFState.shearJammingThreshold ≤ self.shearJammedDDFState.shearRate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • shearJammingFlag : self.shearJammedDDFState.shearJammingCrossed = true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • baselineDDFReady : self.baselineDDFState.comparisonReady
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • shearJammedDDFReady : self.shearJammedDDFState.comparisonReady
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • sameFrequency : self.baselineTransfer.path.frequency.hz = self.shearJammedTransfer.path.frequency.hz
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • sameElectricalInput : self.baselineTransfer.electricalInputPower.watts = self.shearJammedTransfer.electricalInputPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • sameAuxiliaryPathInput : self.baselineTransfer.auxiliaryPathInputPower.watts = self.shearJammedTransfer.auxiliaryPathInputPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • sameOrderedStack : self.baselineTransfer.path.sameStackGeometry self.shearJammedTransfer.path
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • sameTransmitterEfficiency : self.baselineTransfer.transmitterEfficiency.value = self.shearJammedTransfer.transmitterEfficiency.value
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • sameReceiverEfficiency : self.baselineTransfer.receiverEfficiency.value = self.shearJammedTransfer.receiverEfficiency.value
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • thermalControlPassed : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • thermalControlPassed_hypothesis : self.thermalControlPassed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • shamControlPassed : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • shamControlPassed_hypothesis : self.shamControlPassed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • detectorCalibration : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • detectorCalibration_hypothesis : self.detectorCalibration
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • transferDifferenceWatts : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • transferDifferenceLaw : self.transferDifferenceWatts = self.shearJammedMeasurement.observedPower - self.baselineMeasurement.observedPower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • transferDifferenceUncertaintyWatts : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • transferDifferenceUncertainty_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.transferDifferenceUncertaintyWatts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • replicationCount : ℕ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • replicationCount_min : 2 ≤ self.replicationCount
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • artifactReference : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Instances For

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            def Signals.Pending.DDFUltrasonicTransferComparison.comparisonReady (comparison : DDFUltrasonicTransferComparison) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Prop

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The DDF-UPT comparison is ready only for a calibrated, replicated, energy-closed pair of matched runs with a resolved transfer difference.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              theorem Signals.Pending.DDFUltrasonicTransferComparison.not_ready_without_calibrated_measurement (comparison : DDFUltrasonicTransferComparison) (notMeasured : comparison.evidenceStatus ≠ UPTEvidenceStatus.calibratedMeasurement) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ¬comparison.comparisonReady

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Simulated or proposed UPT data cannot pass the calibrated-measurement gate.
