                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      structure Signals.Pending.EHTShadowRingObservation :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      EHT ring/shadow bookkeeping that keeps image observables separate from inferred geometric scales. The ring is not treated as a direct Schwarzschild radius measurement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • sourceLabel : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • artifactReference : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • observableLayer : EHTObservableLayer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • metricReference : EHTMetricReference
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ringDiameterMicroarcsec : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ringDiameter_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.ringDiameterMicroarcsec
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ringDiameterUncertaintyMicroarcsec : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ringDiameterUncertainty_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.ringDiameterUncertaintyMicroarcsec
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • angularGravitationalRadiusMicroarcsec : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • angularGravitationalRadius_pos : 0 < self.angularGravitationalRadiusMicroarcsec
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • schwarzschildRadiusMicroarcsec : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • schwarzschildRadiusLaw : self.schwarzschildRadiusMicroarcsec = 2 * self.angularGravitationalRadiusMicroarcsec
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ringScaleFactor : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ringScaleFactor_pos : 0 < self.ringScaleFactor
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ringDiameterLaw : self.ringDiameterMicroarcsec = self.ringScaleFactor * self.angularGravitationalRadiusMicroarcsec
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • shadowScaleFactor : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • shadowScaleFactor_pos : 0 < self.shadowScaleFactor
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • inferredShadowDiameterMicroarcsec : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • inferredShadowDiameter_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.inferredShadowDiameterMicroarcsec
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • inferredShadowDiameterLaw : self.inferredShadowDiameterMicroarcsec = self.shadowScaleFactor * self.angularGravitationalRadiusMicroarcsec
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • centralBrightnessDepression : Propagation.BoundedFactor
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ringEmissionInterpretation : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ringEmissionInterpretation_hypothesis : self.ringEmissionInterpretation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • modelResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • modelResidual_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.modelResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • modelTolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • modelTolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.modelTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • modelWithinTolerance : self.modelResidual ≤ self.modelTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • calibrationReady : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • calibrationReady_hypothesis : self.calibrationReady
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        theorem Signals.Pending.EHTShadowRingObservation.schwarzschild_radius_holds (observation : EHTShadowRingObservation) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        observation.schwarzschildRadiusMicroarcsec = 2 * observation.angularGravitationalRadiusMicroarcsec

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The angular Schwarzschild scale is a separate derived reference quantity.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A Madelung/GP splat exposes nonnegative diagonal covariance data.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              structure Signals.Pending.WKBBarrier :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A finite WKB/Gamow barrier model with an effective metric factor.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • properDistanceFactor : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • properDistanceFactor_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.properDistanceFactor
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • effectiveBarrier : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • effectiveBarrier_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.effectiveBarrier
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • exponent : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • exponent_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.exponent
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • exponentLaw : self.exponent = self.properDistanceFactor * √self.effectiveBarrier
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • tunnelingProbability : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • probabilityLaw : self.tunnelingProbability = Real.exp (-2 * self.exponent)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem Signals.Pending.WKBBarrier.exponent_holds (barrier : WKBBarrier) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                barrier.exponent = barrier.properDistanceFactor * √barrier.effectiveBarrier

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The WKB exponent is consistent with its supplied metric and barrier terms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem Signals.Pending.WKBBarrier.probability_bounds (barrier : WKBBarrier) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                0 ≤ barrier.tunnelingProbability ∧ barrier.tunnelingProbability ≤ 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A WKB/Gamow probability lies in [0, 1] under the pending barrier assumptions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A pending anti-Amplituhedron phase profile.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Negative divergence is a supplied repulsive-profile hypothesis; it is not identified with a force or a vacuum-pressure change by this definition alone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • phaseGradient : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • phaseGradient_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.phaseGradient
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • divergence : ℝ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • profileWeight : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • profileWeight_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.profileWeight
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • pressureExpansion : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • expansionLaw : self.pressureExpansion = -self.divergence * self.profileWeight

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  0 ≤ profile.pressureExpansion

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A divergent pending profile has nonnegative expansion in its scalar model.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          structure Signals.Pending.GroundDrivenAntiFireDevice :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A pending ground-driven anti-fire device with explicit local power accounting.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The thermal and piezoelectric fields are harvested source-power measurements or assumptions. They do not establish that a landfill fire is extinguished or that the device is self-powered until the corresponding field values are measured.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • member : GroundDrivenMember
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • suppression : AntiFireSuppression
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • memberLength : Units.Length
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • memberLength_positive : 0 < self.memberLength.meters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • memberRadius : Units.Length
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • memberRadius_positive : 0 < self.memberRadius.meters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • insertionStroke : Units.Length
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • insertionStroke_positive : 0 < self.insertionStroke.meters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • insertionForce : Units.Force
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • insertionForce_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.insertionForce.newtons
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • thermalHarvestedPower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • thermalHarvestedPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.thermalHarvestedPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • piezoelectricHarvestedPower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • piezoelectricHarvestedPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.piezoelectricHarvestedPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • conversionEfficiency : Propagation.BoundedFactor
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • batteryPower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • batteryPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.batteryPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • externalInputPower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • externalInputPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.externalInputPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • emitterPower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • emitterPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.emitterPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • inputPowerLaw : self.emitterPower.watts ≤ (self.thermalHarvestedPower.watts + self.piezoelectricHarvestedPower.watts + self.batteryPower.watts + self.externalInputPower.watts) * self.conversionEfficiency.value
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Signals.Pending.GroundDrivenAntiFireDevice.harvestedPower_nonnegative (device : GroundDrivenAntiFireDevice) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            0 ≤ device.thermalHarvestedPower.watts + device.piezoelectricHarvestedPower.watts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The device's two declared harvesting channels are nonnegative.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Signals.Pending.GroundDrivenAntiFireDevice.availableInputPower_nonnegative (device : GroundDrivenAntiFireDevice) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            0 ≤ device.thermalHarvestedPower.watts + device.piezoelectricHarvestedPower.watts + device.batteryPower.watts + device.externalInputPower.watts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            All declared source channels provide nonnegative input power.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Signals.Pending.GroundDrivenAntiFireDevice.emitterPower_le_availableInputPower (device : GroundDrivenAntiFireDevice) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            device.emitterPower.watts ≤ (device.thermalHarvestedPower.watts + device.piezoelectricHarvestedPower.watts + device.batteryPower.watts + device.externalInputPower.watts) * device.conversionEfficiency.value

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The emitter budget cannot exceed the declared total input-power contract.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            structure Signals.Pending.FusionReaction :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A fusion reaction model with explicit probability and energy accounting.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • reactionProbability : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • probability_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.reactionProbability
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • probability_le_one : self.reactionProbability ≤ 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • energyPerReaction : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • energyPerReaction_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.energyPerReaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • reactionRate : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • reactionRate_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.reactionRate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • inputPower : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • inputPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.inputPower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • outputPower : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • outputPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.outputPower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • outputLaw : self.outputPower = self.energyPerReaction * self.reactionRate * self.reactionProbability
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Instances For

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              structure Signals.Pending.DeterministicFusionClaim :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A deterministic-fusion claim makes unit reaction probability explicit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • reaction : FusionReaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • probabilityOne : self.reaction.reactionProbability = 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem Signals.Pending.DeterministicFusionClaim.outputLaw (claim : DeterministicFusionClaim) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                claim.reaction.outputPower = claim.reaction.energyPerReaction * claim.reaction.reactionRate

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Under the pending deterministic claim, output follows the reaction-rate law.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                structure Signals.Pending.EnergyLedger :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                An energy ledger with control, fuel, and explicitly declared spacetime input.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • controlPower : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • controlPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.controlPower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • fuelPower : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • fuelPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.fuelPower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • spacetimePower : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • spacetimePower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.spacetimePower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • outputPower : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • outputPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.outputPower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lossPower : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lossPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.lossPower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • balance : self.outputPower + self.lossPower = self.controlPower + self.fuelPower + self.spacetimePower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem Signals.Pending.EnergyLedger.output_le_declared_input (ledger : EnergyLedger) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ledger.outputPower ≤ ledger.controlPower + ledger.fuelPower + ledger.spacetimePower

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A balanced ledger cannot output more than all declared inputs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  structure Signals.Pending.SpacetimeExtractionClaim :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  An over-unity claim relative to control and fuel requires positive declared spacetime input in the pending ledger.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ledger : EnergyLedger
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • overControlAndFuel : self.ledger.outputPower > self.ledger.controlPower + self.ledger.fuelPower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem Signals.Pending.SpacetimeExtractionClaim.spacetimePower_positive (claim : SpacetimeExtractionClaim) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    0 < claim.ledger.spacetimePower

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Experimental energy-extraction boundary #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The accepted classical library already proves passive MHD and active-optical input/output bounds. The following record is the missing measurement boundary for a claimed over-unity result. It requires every declared power channel, stored-energy change, uncertainty, controls, and replication to be supplied as data. It does not assert that spacetime power exists, that a DCE process is vacuum-powered, or that a control-only ratio is an efficiency.
