                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • exportedOutputPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.exportedOutputPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • measuredLossPower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • measuredLossPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.measuredLossPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • storedEnergyChange : Units.Energy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • storedEnergyChangeLaw : self.storedEnergyChange.joules = (self.controlInputPower.watts + self.motiveInputPower.watts + self.pumpInputPower.watts + self.auxiliaryInputPower.watts - self.exportedOutputPower.watts - self.measuredLossPower.watts) * self.observationDuration.seconds
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • balanceResidualPower : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • balanceResidualPowerLaw : self.balanceResidualPower = self.exportedOutputPower.watts + self.storedEnergyChange.joules / self.observationDuration.seconds + self.measuredLossPower.watts - (self.controlInputPower.watts + self.motiveInputPower.watts + self.pumpInputPower.watts + self.auxiliaryInputPower.watts)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • balanceTolerancePower : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • balanceTolerancePower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.balanceTolerancePower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • balanceWithinTolerance : |self.balanceResidualPower| ≤ self.balanceTolerancePower
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • independentCalibration : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • independentCalibration_hypothesis : self.independentCalibration
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • negativeControlPassed : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • negativeControlPassed_hypothesis : self.negativeControlPassed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • replicationCount : ℕ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • replicationCount_min : 2 ≤ self.replicationCount
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • interpretation : EnergyExtractionInterpretation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          def Signals.Pending.EnergyExtractionEvidence.totalInputPower (evidence : EnergyExtractionEvidence) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Units.Power

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The complete measured input power includes control, motive, pump, and auxiliary channels.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Signals.Pending.EnergyExtractionEvidence.exported_power_balance (evidence : EnergyExtractionEvidence) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            evidence.exportedOutputPower.watts + evidence.storedEnergyChange.joules / evidence.observationDuration.seconds + evidence.measuredLossPower.watts = evidence.totalInputPower.watts + evidence.balanceResidualPower

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A complete ledger's exported power is bounded by total input, losses, and the rate of stored-energy decrease.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            def Signals.Pending.EnergyExtractionEvidence.supportsAdditionalSource (evidence : EnergyExtractionEvidence) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Prop

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A candidate additional-source interpretation requires a complete, replicated and independently calibrated ledger with residual outside the declared bound. This is a test predicate over observations, not a theorem that an extra source exists.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              theorem Signals.Pending.EnergyExtractionEvidence.not_supported_within_tolerance (evidence : EnergyExtractionEvidence) (residualWithinTolerance : |evidence.balanceResidualPower| ≤ evidence.balanceTolerancePower) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ¬evidence.supportsAdditionalSource

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A residual within tolerance cannot support an additional-source claim.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              structure Signals.Pending.FlatLightLithography :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A pending flat-light lithography state generated in an N-LIG or similar waveguide.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Flat light is hypothesized as a state with infinite effective mass, modeled by setting the group velocity dispersion toward zero. This record does not physically establish the existence of a perfectly non-diffracting topological fluid.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • maskVoltage : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • maskVoltage_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.maskVoltage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • effectiveMass : ℝ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • nonlinearCoupling : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • phaseSlipGradient : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • phaseSlipGradient_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.phaseSlipGradient
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • diffractionBlur : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • diffractionBlur_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.diffractionBlur
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • diffractionBlur_near_zero : self.diffractionBlur = 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem Signals.Pending.FlatLightLithography.zero_diffraction (model : FlatLightLithography) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                model.diffractionBlur = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                In the idealized pending model, diffraction blur is strictly zero.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                structure Signals.Pending.PhaseSlipCleavage :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The cleavage of PCLP photo-resist by a Proca phase-gradient.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                This record hypothesizes that the cleavage rate is driven by the longitudinal divergence (phase-slip) rather than ordinary UV/EUV photon absorption.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • photoresistBindingEnergy : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • photoresistBindingEnergy_positive : 0 < self.photoresistBindingEnergy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • phaseSlipAmplitude : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • phaseSlipAmplitude_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.phaseSlipAmplitude
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • cleavageRate : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • cleavageRate_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.cleavageRate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • rateLaw : self.cleavageRate = self.phaseSlipAmplitude / self.photoresistBindingEnergy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem Signals.Pending.PhaseSlipCleavage.rate_nonnegative (cleavage : PhaseSlipCleavage) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  0 ≤ cleavage.cleavageRate

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The hypothesized cleavage rate is nonnegative given the binding energy bounding.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Measured N-LIG and Flat-Light propagation boundaries #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  These records keep the first engineering endpoints separate from the speculative Proca and phase-slip interpretations. A reproducible N-LIG process is a materials result; a bounded PSF broadening result is a propagation measurement. Neither result establishes a fundamental photon mass.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      CW vitrimer lithography state bookkeeping #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The active chat's VitrimerLithography block is retained as finite material and process data. Its CW fluence, temperature, carbon-state, and optional nitrogen state are observations or calibrated process labels; they do not prove an athermal Proca transformation, superconductivity, or atomically precise doping.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A finite aperture-matched Flat-Light propagation observation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • modeLabel : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • controlLabel : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • wavelength : Units.Length
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • wavelength_positive : 0 < self.wavelength.meters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • apertureDiameter : Units.Length
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • apertureDiameter_positive : 0 < self.apertureDiameter.meters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • propagationDistance : Units.Length
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • propagationDistance_positive : 0 < self.propagationDistance.meters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • inputPower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • inputPower_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.inputPower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • initialSecondMomentRadius : Units.Length
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • initialSecondMomentRadius_positive : 0 < self.initialSecondMomentRadius.meters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • finalSecondMomentRadius : Units.Length
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • finalSecondMomentRadius_positive : 0 < self.finalSecondMomentRadius.meters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • broadening : Units.Length
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • broadeningLaw : self.broadening.meters = self.finalSecondMomentRadius.meters - self.initialSecondMomentRadius.meters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • broadeningUncertainty : Units.Length
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • broadeningUncertainty_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.broadeningUncertainty.meters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • psfResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • psfResidual_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.psfResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • mtfResidual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • mtfResidual_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.mtfResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • sideLobeEnergyFraction : Propagation.BoundedFactor
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • apertureMatchedControl : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • apertureMatchedControl_hypothesis : self.apertureMatchedControl
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • detectorCalibration : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • detectorCalibration_hypothesis : self.detectorCalibration
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • replicationCount : ℕ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • replicationCount_min : 2 ≤ self.replicationCount
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • artifactReference : String

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A propagation observation is bounded by its declared broadening uncertainty.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          def Signals.Pending.FlatLightPropagationObservation.supportsBoundedFlatLightClaim (observation : FlatLightPropagationObservation) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Prop

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A zero-broadening candidate requires controls and replication; it remains a finite measurement predicate rather than a theorem of nondiffraction.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Instances For

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Shared evidence and calibration boundaries #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            These records retain the raw scalar readings, instrument calibration, repeated trials, uncertainty intervals, and control slots needed before a Pending model can be compared with a classical baseline. They are evidence contracts rather than evidence claims: every numerical law remains supplied model data.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            structure Signals.Pending.UncertaintyInterval :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A closed scalar interval used to report a calibrated uncertainty range.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • lower : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • upper : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • lower_le_upper : self.lower ≤ self.upper
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              def Signals.Pending.UncertaintyInterval.contains (interval : UncertaintyInterval) (value : ℝ) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Prop

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Membership in a supplied closed uncertainty interval.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem Signals.Pending.UncertaintyInterval.endpoints_ordered (interval : UncertaintyInterval) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                interval.lower ≤ interval.upper

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The interval endpoints retain their declared ordering.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                structure Signals.Pending.CalibratedObservation :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                An observation with raw data, an affine instrument calibration, and an explicit interval containing its calibrated value.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • rawValue : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • calibration : NonDestructive.CalibrationRecord
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • rawValueLaw : self.calibration.rawBefore = self.rawValue
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • calibratedValue : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • calibratedValueLaw : self.calibratedValue = self.calibration.calibrated
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • uncertainty : UncertaintyInterval
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • calibratedWithinUncertainty : self.uncertainty.contains self.calibratedValue
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem Signals.Pending.CalibratedObservation.raw_value_holds (observation : CalibratedObservation) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  observation.calibration.rawBefore = observation.rawValue

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The raw reading used by an observation is retained by its calibration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem Signals.Pending.CalibratedObservation.calibrated_value_holds (observation : CalibratedObservation) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  observation.calibratedValue = observation.calibration.calibrated

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The calibrated observation follows its instrument calibration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • flowBoundary : MeasurementMethod
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • compressibleFlow : MeasurementMethod
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • synthetic : MeasurementMethod
