                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        structure Signals.Pending.MethodCalibration :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A method-specific calibration and environmental metadata record.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • method : MeasurementMethod
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • unitLabel : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • referenceStandard : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • instrumentCalibration : NonDestructive.CalibrationRecord
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • detectorLoss : Propagation.BoundedFactor
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • repeatabilityUncertainty : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • repeatabilityUncertainty_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.repeatabilityUncertainty
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • environmentalDrift : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • environmentalDrift_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.environmentalDrift
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • frequencyDependentNoise : Option (Units.Frequency → ℝ)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          structure Signals.Pending.RepeatedObservation :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Repeated calibrated observations with an explicit summary and uncertainty.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The summary law is an arithmetic mean of the retained calibrated trial values; the nonempty premise prevents the evidence record from describing an empty trial run.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • methodCalibration : MethodCalibration
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • trials : List CalibratedObservation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • trials_nonempty : self.trials ≠ []
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • summary : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • summaryLaw : self.summary = (List.map (fun (trial : CalibratedObservation) => trial.calibratedValue) self.trials).sum / ↑self.trials.length
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • summaryUncertainty : UncertaintyInterval
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • summaryWithinUncertainty : self.summaryUncertainty.contains self.summary
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Signals.Pending.RepeatedObservation.trials_length_pos (observation : RepeatedObservation) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            0 < observation.trials.length

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The retained trial count is positive because the run is nonempty.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Signals.Pending.RepeatedObservation.summary_holds (observation : RepeatedObservation) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            observation.summary = (List.map (fun (trial : CalibratedObservation) => trial.calibratedValue) observation.trials).sum / ↑observation.trials.length

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The repeated observation exposes its supplied arithmetic summary law.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            structure Signals.Pending.ControlledMeasurement :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A controlled comparison between repeated observations and a scalar baseline.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The optional control slots are deliberately separate: positive and negative controls test different failure modes, while held-out and synthetic checks test generalization and pipeline correctness.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • baseline : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • baselineName : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • observation : RepeatedObservation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • residual : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • residualLaw : self.residual = self.observation.summary - self.baseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • tolerance : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • tolerance_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.tolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • positiveControl : Option RepeatedObservation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • negativeControl : Option RepeatedObservation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • heldOutCheck : Option RepeatedObservation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • syntheticCheck : Option RepeatedObservation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              def Signals.Pending.ControlledMeasurement.consistent (measurement : ControlledMeasurement) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Prop

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A controlled measurement agrees with its baseline within tolerance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                def Signals.Pending.ControlledMeasurement.anomalyCandidate (measurement : ControlledMeasurement) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Prop

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                An out-of-tolerance controlled result is an anomaly candidate, not a diagnosis of its proposed mechanism.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem Signals.Pending.ControlledMeasurement.residual_holds (measurement : ControlledMeasurement) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  measurement.residual = measurement.observation.summary - measurement.baseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The controlled residual follows the baseline comparison law.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem Signals.Pending.ControlledMeasurement.consistent_iff (measurement : ControlledMeasurement) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  measurement.consistent ↔ |measurement.residual| ≤ measurement.tolerance

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The consistency predicate exposes its calibrated residual inequality.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem Signals.Pending.ControlledMeasurement.anomalyCandidate_iff (measurement : ControlledMeasurement) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  measurement.anomalyCandidate ↔ ¬|measurement.residual| ≤ measurement.tolerance

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The anomaly predicate exposes its out-of-tolerance interpretation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem Signals.Pending.ControlledMeasurement.consistent_or_anomaly (measurement : ControlledMeasurement) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  measurement.consistent ∨ measurement.anomalyCandidate

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Every controlled result is either within tolerance or an anomaly candidate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  structure Signals.Pending.FlowBoundaryEvidence :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A flow-boundary adapter linking scalar controlled measurements to the pressure, heat-flux, and velocity residuals of a boundary observation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • boundary : FlowBoundaryObservation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • pressure : ControlledMeasurement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • pressureMethodLaw : self.pressure.observation.methodCalibration.method = MeasurementMethod.flowBoundary
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • pressureSummaryLaw : self.pressure.observation.summary = self.boundary.measured.pressure.pascals
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • pressureBaselineLaw : self.pressure.baseline = self.boundary.predicted.pressure.pascals
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • pressureResidualLaw : self.pressure.residual = self.boundary.pressureResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • pressureToleranceLaw : self.pressure.tolerance = self.boundary.pressureTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • heatFlux : ControlledMeasurement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • heatFluxMethodLaw : self.heatFlux.observation.methodCalibration.method = MeasurementMethod.flowBoundary
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • heatFluxSummaryLaw : self.heatFlux.observation.summary = self.boundary.measured.heatFlux.wattsPerSquareMeter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • heatFluxBaselineLaw : self.heatFlux.baseline = self.boundary.predicted.heatFlux.wattsPerSquareMeter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • heatFluxResidualLaw : self.heatFlux.residual = self.boundary.heatFluxResidual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • heatFluxToleranceLaw : self.heatFlux.tolerance = self.boundary.heatFluxTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • velocity : Fin 3 → ControlledMeasurement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • velocityMethodLaw (axis : Fin 3) : (self.velocity axis).observation.methodCalibration.method = MeasurementMethod.flowBoundary
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • velocitySummaryLaw (axis : Fin 3) : (self.velocity axis).observation.summary = (self.boundary.measured.velocity axis).metersPerSecond
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • velocityBaselineLaw (axis : Fin 3) : (self.velocity axis).baseline = (self.boundary.predicted.velocity axis).metersPerSecond
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • velocityResidualLaw (axis : Fin 3) : (self.velocity axis).residual = self.boundary.velocityResidual axis
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • velocityToleranceLaw (axis : Fin 3) : (self.velocity axis).tolerance = self.boundary.velocityTolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem Signals.Pending.FlowBoundaryEvidence.pressure_consistent (evidence : FlowBoundaryEvidence) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    evidence.pressure.consistent

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The flow adapter inherits the pressure residual tolerance check.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem Signals.Pending.FlowBoundaryEvidence.heat_flux_consistent (evidence : FlowBoundaryEvidence) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    evidence.heatFlux.consistent

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The flow adapter inherits the heat-flux residual tolerance check.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem Signals.Pending.FlowBoundaryEvidence.velocity_consistent (evidence : FlowBoundaryEvidence) (axis : Fin 3) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (evidence.velocity axis).consistent

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The flow adapter inherits each componentwise velocity tolerance check.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    structure Signals.Pending.CompressibleFlowComparison :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A finite measured-or-simulated comparison for a compressible-flow run.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The control volume supplies classical mass-flow, momentum, and heat baselines; acoustic output remains an explicit baseline because it is not part of the scalar control-volume energy fields. This record compares supplied data and does not execute a CFD solver or establish a plume-performance claim.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • boundary : FlowBoundaryEvidence

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • acousticBaseline_nonnegative : 0 ≤ self.acousticBaseline.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • acousticPowerBaselineLaw : self.acousticPower.baseline = self.acousticBaseline.watts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                structure Signals.Pending.CompressibleFlowDataset (sampleCount : ℕ) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A finite provenance bridge from indexed flow data to Pending comparisons.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The raw boundary observations are retained and linked to each comparison, but the record does not parse external files, solve fluid equations, or establish that a simulated case matches a physical plume.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • origin : FlowDataOrigin
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • caseName : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • sourceLabel : String
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • metadata : FlowDatasetMetadata
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • samples : Fin sampleCount → CompressibleFlowComparison
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • sampleCount_positive : 0 < sampleCount
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • rawBoundary : Fin sampleCount → FlowBoundaryObservation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • rawBoundaryLaw (index : Fin sampleCount) : self.rawBoundary index = (self.samples index).boundary.boundary
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Instances For

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Prop

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A dataset is ready for an ingestion adapter when its index and provenance metadata are present. This is a bookkeeping gate, not a data-quality claim.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    0 < sampleCount
