                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Each retained raw boundary observation is linked to its comparison sample.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Wakefield, Bi-Twistor Momentum Sink, DDF Hull Stress, and Cryogenic AMB Spool Hypotheses #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The records below formalize the conditional and unvalidated premises from Twistors-and-Positive-Grassmannian-Interference.md:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1. TwistorMomentumSinkHypothesis records the unclosed dual-spacetime polygon residual ΔP_wake = x_n - x_1 and n + 2 Grassmannian bi-twistor sink while enforcing exact classical momentum conservation ΔP_craft + ΔP_wake = 0.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2. PulsedWakefieldHalbachHypothesis bounds extracted pulse energy by the Dawson-limited electrostatic energy stored in the cavity volume and bounds time-averaged thrust by the duty-cycle-scaled peak pulse force.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3. DDFPhaseSlipHullStressHypothesis requires a strictly positive density floor (0 < ρ_floor ≤ ρ) at the hull boundary and requires external drive power to cover the mechanical thrust power (F_thrust * v ≤ P_drive), ruling out unpowered reactionless propulsion above the Landau critical velocity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    4. CryogenicSpoolAMBHypothesis records the He-3 critical temperature (3.32 K), minimum solidification pressure (3.4 MPa), MgB₂ critical temperature (39 K), thermosyphon density ordering, and 5-axis AMB air-gap clearance, distinguishing supercritical gas operation at 39 K from liquid or solid He-3.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    structure Signals.Pending.TwistorMomentumSinkHypothesis :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A Pending bi-twistor momentum-sink hypothesis for wakefield momentum transfer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    When a localized wave or particle system exchanges momentum wakefieldMomentum with a macroscopic plasma or vortex bath, the dual polygon fails to close by dualPolygonEnd - dualPolygonStart, and the net vehicle momentum change must balance the momentum absorbed by the sink.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • particleCount : ℕ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • expandedGrassmannianColumns : ℕ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • expandedColumnsLaw : self.expandedGrassmannianColumns = self.particleCount + 2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • dualPolygonStart : Maxwell.Vector3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • dualPolygonEnd : Maxwell.Vector3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • wakefieldMomentum : Maxwell.Vector3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • polygonClosureResidualLaw : self.wakefieldMomentum = self.dualPolygonEnd - self.dualPolygonStart
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • craftMomentumChange : Maxwell.Vector3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • momentumBalanceLaw : self.craftMomentumChange + self.wakefieldMomentum = 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem Signals.Pending.TwistorMomentumSinkHypothesis.craft_momentum_opposite_wake (hypothesis : TwistorMomentumSinkHypothesis) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      hypothesis.craftMomentumChange = -hypothesis.wakefieldMomentum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The vehicle momentum change is equal and opposite to the momentum absorbed by the wakefield sink.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem Signals.Pending.TwistorMomentumSinkHypothesis.closed_polygon_zero_thrust (hypothesis : TwistorMomentumSinkHypothesis) (closed : hypothesis.dualPolygonEnd = hypothesis.dualPolygonStart) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      hypothesis.craftMomentumChange = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      If the dual polygon closes (dualPolygonEnd = dualPolygonStart), zero momentum is transferred to the wakefield and the vehicle receives zero net impulse.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      structure Signals.Pending.PulsedWakefieldHalbachHypothesis :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A Pending pulsed Langmuir/Proca wakefield cavity with Halbach Faraday extraction and UHV solid-state transformer buffering.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Stored cavity wave energy is bounded by the Dawson wave-breaking ceiling over the finite cavity volume, and time-averaged thrust obeys duty-cycle scaling.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • permittivity : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • permittivity_nonneg : 0 ≤ self.permittivity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • fieldAmplitude : Units.ElectricFieldAmplitude
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • fieldAmplitude_nonneg : 0 ≤ self.fieldAmplitude.voltsPerMeter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • dawsonFieldCeiling : Units.ElectricFieldAmplitude
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • fieldBoundedByDawson : self.fieldAmplitude.voltsPerMeter ≤ self.dawsonFieldCeiling.voltsPerMeter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • cavityVolume : Units.Volume
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • cavityVolume_nonneg : 0 ≤ self.cavityVolume.cubicMeters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • storedWaveEnergy : Units.Energy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • storedEnergyLaw : self.storedWaveEnergy.joules = MHD.electrostaticWaveEnergyDensity self.permittivity self.fieldAmplitude.voltsPerMeter * self.cavityVolume.cubicMeters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • extractedPulseEnergy : Units.Energy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • extractedEnergy_nonneg : 0 ≤ self.extractedPulseEnergy.joules
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • extractedEnergyBounded : self.extractedPulseEnergy.joules ≤ self.storedWaveEnergy.joules
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • peakThrust : Units.Force
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • peakThrust_nonneg : 0 ≤ self.peakThrust.newtons
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • dutyCycle : Propagation.BoundedFactor
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • averageThrust : Units.Force
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • averageThrustLaw : self.averageThrust = MHD.pulsedAverageForce self.peakThrust self.dutyCycle
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • transmissionVoltage : Units.Voltage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • transmissionVoltage_pos : 0 < self.transmissionVoltage.volts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • calibrated : Prop
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • calibrated_hypothesis : self.calibrated
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        theorem Signals.Pending.PulsedWakefieldHalbachHypothesis.extracted_pulse_energy_le_dawson_ceiling (hypothesis : PulsedWakefieldHalbachHypothesis) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        hypothesis.extractedPulseEnergy.joules ≤ MHD.electrostaticWaveEnergyDensity hypothesis.permittivity hypothesis.dawsonFieldCeiling.voltsPerMeter * hypothesis.cavityVolume.cubicMeters

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Extracted electrical energy per pulse cannot exceed the Dawson saturation energy stored in the finite cavity volume.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        theorem Signals.Pending.PulsedWakefieldHalbachHypothesis.average_thrust_le_peak (hypothesis : PulsedWakefieldHalbachHypothesis) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        hypothesis.averageThrust.newtons ≤ hypothesis.peakThrust.newtons

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Time-averaged pulsed thrust cannot exceed the peak pulse force.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        structure Signals.Pending.DDFPhaseSlipHullStressHypothesis :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A Pending DDF phase-slip hull-stress hypothesis with explicit core-density regularization and external drive-power accounting.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Supercritical vortex shedding (criticalVelocity < flowVelocity) is dissipative unless driven by an external power source externalDrivePower satisfying inferredThrust * flowVelocity ≤ externalDrivePower.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • substrate : DDF.DDFSubstrate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • hbar : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • hbar_pos : 0 < self.hbar
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • winding : ℤ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • winding_nonzero : self.winding ≠ 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • densityFloor : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • densityFloor_pos : 0 < self.densityFloor
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • boundaryDensity : ℝ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • densityAboveFloor : self.densityFloor ≤ self.boundaryDensity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • flowVelocity : Units.Speed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • flowVelocity_pos : 0 < self.flowVelocity.metersPerSecond
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • criticalVelocity : Units.Speed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • criticalVelocity_pos : 0 < self.criticalVelocity.metersPerSecond
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • supercriticalFlow : self.criticalVelocity.metersPerSecond < self.flowVelocity.metersPerSecond
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • hullArea : Units.Area
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • hullArea_pos : 0 < self.hullArea.squareMeters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • quantumStressPressure : Units.Pressure
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • quantumStressPressure_nonneg : 0 ≤ self.quantumStressPressure.pascals
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • inferredThrust : Units.Force
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • inferredThrust_nonneg : 0 ≤ self.inferredThrust.newtons
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • thrustLaw : self.inferredThrust.newtons = self.quantumStressPressure.pascals * self.hullArea.squareMeters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • mechanicalThrustPower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • mechanicalPowerLaw : self.mechanicalThrustPower.watts = self.inferredThrust.newtons * self.flowVelocity.metersPerSecond
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • externalDrivePower : Units.Power
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • externalDrivePower_nonneg : 0 ≤ self.externalDrivePower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • drivePowerCoversThrust : self.mechanicalThrustPower.watts ≤ self.externalDrivePower.watts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          theorem Signals.Pending.DDFPhaseSlipHullStressHypothesis.boundary_density_pos (hypothesis : DDFPhaseSlipHullStressHypothesis) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          0 < hypothesis.boundaryDensity

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Regularized hull-boundary density is strictly positive, preventing division by zero in the Bohm quantum potential at the hull interface.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3-Zone $400 \to 800\text{ GHz}$ rGO-polyCBD-SS-Lignin Hyperbolic SFG Cannon & Hydroxyl Quenching Boundary #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The record below scopes the chat's 3-zone rGO-polyCBD-SS-Lignin $400 \to 800\text{ GHz}$ Sum-Frequency Generation (SFG) lens, Denisov mode-conversion coupler, and hydroxyl ($\cdot\mathrm{OH}$) spin-singlet radical-quenching narrative (data/chats/IQ-Sampling-for-Signal-Phase.md, lines 15855–17335):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. It enforces exact Zone 1 ($400\text{ GHz}$) and Zone 3 ($800\text{ GHz}$) ENZ fill fractions ($141/5641$ and $141/1516$, rather than the detuned $9.88\%$ table entry).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2. It records the hydroxyl spectroscopic frequency gap between the true $X^2\Pi_{3/2}$ $\Lambda$-doubling hyperfine maser transition ($\approx 1.667\text{ GHz}$), the proposed $800\text{ GHz}$ SFG beam, and the fundamental rotational transition ($\approx 1.83\text{ THz}$).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3. It requires explicit accounting for the exothermic heat released by $\cdot\mathrm{OH} + \mathrm{H}\cdot + M \to \mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} + M$ ($\Delta H_{\mathrm{rec}} \approx 499\text{ kJ/mol} > 0$) and enforces a unit-consistent joule-level thermal balance requiring an external heat sink (removedHeatJoules) to bring the treated volume below reignitionThresholdJoules.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Madelung Variational Action & Dilatant-Phase ($\varphi$) Jamming Evidence Boundary #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The theorems in Signals.DDF (madelung_lagrangian_variational_and_dilatant_jamming_identities) verify that substituting $\psi = \sqrt{\rho} e^{i S / \hbar}$ into the Gross–Pitaevskii Lagrangian density yields the hydrodynamic continuity and Quantum Hamilton–Jacobi equations, and that adding the dilatant sheath-compression coupling recovers $\Lambda_\parallel(v) = \gamma_\varphi(v) = (1 - v^2/c^2)^{-1/2}$ and $d\tau_D = dt / \gamma_\varphi(v)$. The Pending record below separates that checked variational algebra from the experimental question of whether the vacuum itself is a two-phase dilatant medium versus a curved Lorentzian manifold (η_act^γ = 0 vs. 1), or whether a laboratory shear-thickening colloidal/BEC analog realizes the dilatant dispersion $g(k) = g_0(1 + \gamma_{\mathrm{dil}} k^2)$.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                32. Discovered Materials Problem 04 ("Tuning Materials with Light"): Time-Linear Grassmannian G-GKBA, Hubbard Chains/Ladders, $\mathrm{WSe}_2$, Graphite, & $\mathrm{MgB}_2$ Pending Contract #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                While Signals.DFT.tuning_materials_with_light_gkba_hubbard_wse2_graphite_and_mgb2_identities machine-checks:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. Time-linear Grassmannian Generalized Kadanoff–Baym Ansatz (G-GKBA) complexity reduction $\operatorname{grassmannGKBASpeedupRatio}(N_t, N_{\mathrm{occ}}, N_{\mathrm{basis}}) = N_t^2(N_{\mathrm{basis}}/N_{\mathrm{occ}})^2$ ($1.44\times 10^8\times$ at $N_t = 1000, N_{\mathrm{occ}} = 10, N_{\mathrm{basis}} = 120$),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2. Hubbard 11-site chain correlated double occupancy ($U/J = 0 \to 5 \to 15 \to 20$), doublon relaxation scaling $J^2 / U$, and $6\times 2$ ladder optical conductivity thresholds ($U/J = 3, 6, 12$; Schroedter, Bonitz & Joost, arXiv:2606.10773, 2026),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3. $\mathrm{WSe}_2$ resonant ($1.72\text{ eV}$) and above-gap ($2.48\text{ eV}$) bright/dark exciton energetics ($45\text{ meV}$ splitting), $400\text{ fs}$ momentum-dark buildup, and $0.5$ late-time bright/dark population ratio (Madéo et al., Science 370, 1199 (2020)),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                4. Graphite $35\text{ fs}, 800\text{ nm}, 12\text{ mJ/cm}^2$ five-reservoir energy conservation and $K$-point $A_1'$ SCOP-to-acoustic (LA/TA) relaxation across $0.5, 1.5, 5, 100\text{ ps}$ (René de Cotret et al., Phys. Rev. B 100, 214115 (2019)), and
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                5. $\mathrm{MgB}_2$ $T_c = 38\text{ K}$ lower $\pi$-band gap curve, $0.63\text{ THz}$ monotonic first-harmonic cooling response, $1\text{ THz}$ third-harmonic resonance peak at $7\text{ K}$, and $150\text{ kV/cm}$ $2\text{ ps}$ inductive superfluid conductivity suppression (Katsumi et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 036902 (2025)),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                any claim of ab initio predictive transfer to arbitrary driven crystals or light-induced room-temperature superconductivity above $T_c$ without full Brillouin-zone $GW\text{-}\mathrm{BSE}$ / DFPT electron–phonon matrix elements, multi-band Eliashberg–Nambu–Gor'kov self-consistency, and time-resolved experimental trARPES / UEDS / THz-TDS validation remains governed by LightDrivenMaterialsPendingHypothesis in Signals.Pending.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  33. Discovered Materials Problem 05 ("Predicting Heat Transport across Solid Interfaces"): Grassmannian Thermal Boundary Conductance (G-TBC), $\mathrm{Al/Si}$ & $\mathrm{Al/GaN}$ $80\text{--}700\text{ K}$, $\mathrm{Cu/TiC/diamond}$ $1.48\times$, and $\mathrm{Au/M/PMMA/Si}$ Stack Pending Contract #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  While Signals.DFT.interfacial_heat_transport_gtbc_al_si_gan_tic_and_pmma_identities machine-checks:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. Acoustic Mismatch Model (ammNormalTransmission) symmetry, matched-impedance optimality ($\tau^{\mathrm{AMM}}(Z, Z) = 1$), universal bound ($\tau^{\mathrm{AMM}}(Z_1, Z_2) \le 1$), and Diffuse Mismatch Model (dmmSpectralTransmission) detailed-balance sum rule ($\tau_{12}^{\mathrm{DMM}} + \tau_{21}^{\mathrm{DMM}} = 1$),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. Grassmannian bond-stiffness-weighted $\mathrm{Gr}_{\mathbb{C}}(2,4)$ phonon transmission (gtbcBondWeightedTransmission), proving exact reduction to AMM at $\xi_{\mathrm{bond}} = 0$ and strict ordering under chemical adhesion stiffness ($\tau^{\mathrm{Gr}}(\xi_{\mathrm{weak}}) < \tau^{\mathrm{Gr}}(\xi_{\mathrm{strong}}) \le \tau^{\mathrm{AMM}}$),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. Sharp metal/semiconductor room-temperature conductances ($379\text{ MW\,m}^{-2}\text{\,K}^{-1}$ for $\mathrm{Al}(111)/\mathrm{Si}(111)$ and $423\text{ MW\,m}^{-2}\text{\,K}^{-1}$ for $\mathrm{Al}(111)/\mathrm{GaN}(0001)$), the renewed linear anharmonic 3-phonon rise above $400\text{ K}$ (gtbcHarmonicPlusAnharmonicConductance), and metal-side electron–phonon series resistance (gtbcElectronPhononSeriesConductance; Li et al., Nature Communications 13, 4901 (2022)),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. Geometric-mean Plücker impedance bridging ($\tau^{\mathrm{AMM}}(1, 9) < (\tau^{\mathrm{AMM}}(1, 3))^2 < \tau^{\mathrm{AMM}}(1, 3)$) and the $1.48\times$ conductance enhancement of a $10\text{ nm}$ crystalline $\mathrm{TiC}$ interlayer in $\mathrm{Cu/TiC/diamond}$ (gtbcCuTiCDiamondRatio = 1.48; Chang et al., ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 11, 26507 (2019)), and
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  5. Inorganic/polymer adhesion-layer boundary conductance ordering ($59 < 115 < 139\text{ MW\,m}^{-2}\text{\,K}^{-1}$ for $\mathrm{Au/PMMA/Si}$, $\mathrm{Au/Ti/PMMA/Si}$, and $\mathrm{Au/Ni/PMMA/Si}$) and monotonic PMMA thickness series scaling (gtbcPolymerStackConductance; Sandell et al., Nanomaterials 10, 670 (2020); Losego et al., Appl. Phys. Lett. 97, 011908 (2010)),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  any claim of zero-fit predictive accuracy on arbitrary experimental specimens without accounting for specimen-specific interfacial atomic roughness, native oxide or amorphous interdiffusion layers, TDTR/FDTR optical transducer calibration, and atomistic NEMD/AGF validation remains governed by InterfacialHeatTransportPendingHypothesis in Signals.Pending.
