Discovered Materials Problem 01 ("A Predictive Theory of Cuprate Superconductivity"): #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Grassmannian Zhang–Rice Plücker Pairing (G-CSC), 12 Benchmark Observables, & 5 Cuprate Families Pending Contract

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    While Signals.DFT.cuprate_superconductivity_twelve_targets_and_phase_diagram_identities and Signals.DFT.cuprate_superconductivity_critique_families_and_error_identities machine-check the algebraic and constitutive identities across all 12 benchmark targets of Discovered Materials Problem 01 (dome $T_c(p)$, $d_{x^2-y^2}$ gap symmetry and magnitude, pseudogap $T^*(p)$ closure at $p^* = 0.19$, strange-metal $T$-linear resistivity, Loram pseudogap entropy suppression, Uemura/nodal superfluid stiffness, AF order collapse at $p = 0.05$, persistent zone-boundary paramagnons at $p = 0.30$, $p = 1/8$ CDW peak, $245\text{ K}$ $\mathrm{YBa_2Cu_3O_{6.60}}$ resonant ultrasound peak, O'Mahony charge-transfer superexchange monotonicity, and the 5-family $T_{c,\max}$ hierarchy LSCO $<$ Tl2201 $<$ Bi2212 $<$ YBCO $<$ Hg1201), any claim of room-temperature ambient-pressure superconductivity or specimen-specific vortex-pinning / critical-current engineering remains governed by CuprateSuperconductivityPendingHypothesis in Signals.Pending.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      In any CuprateSuperconductivityPendingHypothesis, the Kotliar–Liu–RVB product dome equals cuprateSuperconductingTc, Pavarini–O'Mahony $T_{c,\max}$ increases strictly with $J_{\mathrm{ZR}}$ and $|t'/t|$, the YRZ pseudogap self-energy vanishes on the nodal Fermi arcs while opening an antinodal gap $\Delta_{\mathrm{PG},0}^2 > 0$, Homes' superfluid scaling and London penetration depth monotonicity hold, the MMP dynamical spin structure factor is strictly positive at paramagnon resonance, the 2D $(p, q)$ CDW peak holds at $p = 1/8$, Loram specific heat is smoothly suppressed without a latent-heat spike at $T^*$, and G-CSC beats unprojected mean-field BCS/FL baselines.

Discovered Materials Problem 02 ("Interfacial Electrical Properties from Processing History"): #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Grassmannian Process-to-Electrical Modeling (G-IEP) Across All 5 Semiconductor Interfaces Pending Contract

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      While Signals.DFT.interfacial_electrical_properties_five_interfaces_and_process_history_identities and Signals.DFT.interfacial_electrical_properties_critique_mcweeny_eot_ss_and_error_identities machine-check the algebraic and constitutive identities across all 5 semiconductor interfaces (planar $\mathrm{Si/SiO_2}$ (100) < (511) < (110) < (111) orientation and $\mathrm{H_2}$ passivation, curved $\mathrm{Si}$ nanowire/nanosheet viscoelastic stress retardation, $\mathrm{SiC/SiO_2}$ face-dependent carbon retardation, $\mathrm{HfO_2/SiO_2/Si}$ interlayer regrowth and EOT scaling, and $\mathrm{Ge/GeO_2}$ volatile $\mathrm{GeO(g)}$ desorption vs. $\mathrm{SiGe}$ snowplow enrichment), any claim of tool-specific wafer electrical qualification without accounting for furnace/RTA ambient trace moisture, wet-chemical pre-clean roughness, and calibrated CV/conductance/DLTS metrology remains governed by InterfacialElectricalPropertiesPendingHypothesis in Signals.Pending.

Grassmannian Multilayer Graphene Superconductivity, QAHE/FQAH, Supersolid Vortices, #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        While Signals.DFT.graphene_rhombohedral_trilayer_pentalayer_superconductivity_and_qc_identities, Signals.DFT.graphene_superconductivity_critique_sum_rule_fqah_and_error_identities, and Signals.DFT.graphene_superconductivity_deep_gap_closure_identities machine-check the algebraic and constitutive identities across all 8 regimes (R1–R8: $N=3$ vs. $N=5$ rhombohedral flat-band bandwidth and interaction ratio $r_s$, $\mathrm{SC}_1$ IVC vs. $\mathrm{SC}_2$ spin-triplet $>10\times$ Pauli-limit violation and R5G quarter-metal chiral $p_x \pm i p_y$ pairing, MATTG light–heavy Kondo hybridization, low-energy optical sum rule and Peotta–Törmä Fubini–Study superfluid stiffness, R5G–WS2 $C = \pm 5$ QAHE, $C=1$ Anomalous Hall Crystal and Jain FQAH fractions $\nu \in \{2/3, 3/5, 4/7, 4/9, 3/7, 2/5\}$, supersolid Leggett fraction and vortex barrier reduction, and QAHE/FQAH–SC Majorana/parafermion quantum computing), any claim of ambient-temperature ($-20^\circ\text{C}$ to $+80^\circ\text{C}$) flux-pinning superconductivity in unmeasured laser-induced or strained rhombohedral graphene pump stators, or fault-tolerant non-Abelian Majorana/parafermion braiding without dilution-refrigerator magnetotransport, SQUID-on-tip, and interferometric braiding verification, remains governed by RhombohedralGrapheneSuperconductivityPendingHypothesis in Signals.Pending.
